name: Differentiable Radiance Derivative Computation
definition: A method to compute radiance derivatives with respect to density analytically, avoiding gradient tracking and redundant operations inherent in automatic differentiation (AD). It derives an analytical form of the radiance transfer equation.
summary: Differentiable Radiance Derivative Computation analytically calculates radiance gradients with respect to volume density, avoiding the overhead of automatic differentiation by deriving direct mathematical forms for efficient optimization.
